canonical_project: Phaeton Networks Dalwallinu Shire modular data centre
notes: Phaeton announced (Jan 2022) deployment of eight ISO containerised modular data centres at Phaeton Energy microgrid solar farms across Australia, including one module at Dalwallinu Shire backed by a 1.5MW solar farm and 6MW battery system; prototype OMD 'ready to go live' at announcement. DCD noted deployment timelines were not shared; no public evidence the Dalwallinu module was deployed or energised, so status announced/lead.
